swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The Moon does not rise at the same time every day. Reason (R): the Moon moves ahead a little in its orbit around the Earth each day, so the Earth must rotate further for the Moon to reach nearly the same position in the sky.

add.q: Assertion (A): The Moon does not rise at the same time every day. Reason (R): The Moon rises later each day by exactly 24 hours, matching one full rotation of the Earth. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): The Indian National Calendar's year begins on 22 March in a normal year. Reason (R): 22 March is the day after the spring equinox.
